name: ULTIMATE SEO
author: abhilash2002

sections.description:
ULTIMATE SEO is a powerful yet lightweight SEO solution designed to help you easily manage all aspects of your website’s on-page search engine optimization.

Key Features:
* Meta Tags Management: Easily customize meta titles and descriptions for improved search engine visibility and click-through rates.
* Schema Markup Support: Add structured data to your pages, helping search engines understand your content better and display rich snippets in search results.
* Social Sharing Optimization: Enhance your social media presence with built-in Open Graph and Twitter Card support, ensuring your content looks great when shared.
* Lightweight & Fast: Built with performance in mind, ensuring it doesn’t slow down your website.

Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced user, ULTIMATE SEO gives you the essential tools to improve your search engine rankings and social media appearance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the abhilash-ultimate-seo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access the ‘Ultimate SEO’ menu in the WordPress admin dashboard to configure global settings such as homepage meta tags and default social images.
  4. Edit any page or post to configure specific SEO settings, open graph details, and schema types using the SEO meta box found below the content editor.

short_description: A lightweight, comprehensive SEO plugin to optimize meta titles, descriptions, schema markup, and social sharing, all while being blazing fast.
